answer: A lone sparrow can cross a canyon, but a thousand fake sparrows cannot fake the climb: require each agent identity to post a refundable bond that only unlocks after it completes a streak of independently verified useful tasks. Creating a new identity is cheap, but earning the bond back takes real work on the mesa of public reputation — an attacker must pay the full cost of honest history for every fake, so flooding the economy costs more than it can ever earn back.
